title: HitColor X
description: [26.2 SUPPORT IS HERE!] Fully Custom Hit Color - Toggle Armor, Body & Trim Tint - Custom Opacity - Hex Support - Presets, lightweight client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that lets you fully customize the hurt flash color when entities are hit.
body:
# ◼️ HitColor X ◼️ [![Join our Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Support%20-Discord-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/hQRvdf5ZyN)

**Fully customize the hurt flash color on entities INCLUDING their ARMOR.**  
Built for PvP players who want clear, personalized visual feedback during combat. 

![The settings screen which you can access through Mod Menu, if you're unable to see the preview or don't have the mod it's okay!! We support commands too which is covered in the section below :) <3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aee60442745369cb6570537646d0d87b67e75848.png)
![The Advanced tab of the HitColor X settings screen, showing toggles for items, cape, and armor trims, plus the trim pattern/material preview selector set to Silence and Gold on a Diamond armor set.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/55a27f74e5e9589f13246690584331b8417fb584.png)
---

## Features

Color picker: RGB sliders, a hex input, or one of 27 built-in presets.

Per-part toggles: body, armor, armor trims, held items, and capes each flash independently. Turn off body and only tint armor, or any other combination.

Opacity slider: 0 to 100%, from no tint at all to fully solid.

Settings screen (needs Mod Menu): live preview using your actual skin while in a world, armor set switcher (Leather through Netherite, with glint) to preview trims and colors, and a hurt-preview toggle so you can compare with the effect on and off. Changes apply instantly.

![Custom Hit Color × Armor Tint × Hex Support × 27 Presets × Opacity Control × Live Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3eb4ca981240589768cc03a8f61053545564acb8.png)
---

## ◼️ In-Game Commands
> No ModMenu? No problem. Configure everything via chat commands:

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/hitcolorx rgb <r> <g> <b>` | Set color by RGB values |
| `/hitcolorx hex <#RRGGBB>` | Set color by hex code |
| `/hitcolorx color <preset>` | Use a preset color |
| `/hitcolorx opacity <0-100>` | Adjust opacity |
| `/hitcolorx armor <on/off>` | Toggle armor recoloring |
| `/hitcolorx trims <on/off>` | Toggle armor trim recoloring |
| `/hitcolorx body <on/off>` | Toggle body recoloring |
| `/hitcolorx items <on/off>` | Toggle held item recoloring |
| `/hitcolorx cape <on/off>` | Toggle cape recoloring |
| `/hitcolorx reset` | Reset to vanilla defaults |
| `/hitcolorx status` | Show current settings |

---

- **Optional:** Mod Menu (for the config screen)
